Product Information
FUEL CELL SYSTEM
Toyota Fuel Cell System (TFCS)
FUEL CELL STACK
Fuel cell stack type Solid polymer electrolyte fuel cell
Humidification system Internal circulation system (humidifier-less)
Power output 128 kW
Output density by volume 4.4 kW/L
Output density by weight 2.0 kW/kg
Cell number of cells in one stack 330 (single-line stacking)
Flow channel 3D fine-mesh flow field (cathode)
Cold start capability -22oF (-30oC)
ELECTRIC MOTOR
Power output 182 hp (134 kW) max
Motor type AC synchronous electric generator
Drive battery Lithium Ion
Battery Power Output 310.8 V
Battery Pack Weight 44.6 kg
Battery Capacity 1.24 kWh
Emission rating Zero Emission Vehicle (ZEV)
HYDROGEN TANKS
Storage method Carbon-fiber reinforced tanks
Number of tanks 3
Type Type 4
Material Three-layer structure:
1. Inner: polymer-lined layer to hold the hydrogen
2. Middle: structural layer of carbon-fiber reinforced
polymer to provide strength
3. Outer: glass-fiber reinforced polymer to help
protect from surface abrasion
Fuel Compressed hydrogen gas
Maximum filling pressure 87.5 MPa
Normal operating pressure 70 MPa (approx. 10,000 psi)
Hydrogen tank capacity (weight) 5.6 kg
Internal volume (total): 142 L
Internal volume front tank 52 L
Internal volume rear tank 25.3 L
Internal volume tunnel tank 64.9 L
MECHANICAL AND PERFORMANCE

Product Information
• Multi-LED front and rear turn signal indicators, clearance lights, and side marker lights
etched with Mirai logo
• Windshield wiper de-icer
• Dual-tone heated power-folding outside mirrors with turn signal indicators, blind spot
warning and puddle lights
• Color-keyed roof-mounted shark-fin antenna
• 19-in. black machine-finished aluminum alloy wheels with P235/55R19, 8J all-season
tires
• Bi-beam auto-leveling LED headlights
• LED taillights and rear combination lights
• Satin-black front grille
• Daytime Running Lights

• Front-seat footwell illumination
• Leather tilt/telescopic steering wheel, Bluetooth® hands-free phone and voice-
command controls
• Dual extendable sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors
• Heated SofTex®-trimmed front seats
• Color digital gauge cluster including drive mode, speedometer, fuel efficiency and MID
• Power windows with one-touch auto up/down on all four doors, jam protection in all
positions with power rear quarter windows
• Digital Key capability (requires Remote Connect trial or subscription; 1-year trial
included)
• Overhead console with dome lights, touch-activated maplights, sunglasses storage and
SOS button
• Front-door map pockets
• Qi-compatible wireless smartphone charging tray with charge indicator light
• Passenger-side lockable glove compartment
• Five-passenger seating with fixed rear seats
• One USB media port, three USB charging ports
• UV-protected and water-repellent side windows
• ALL AUTO control (heated/ventilated seats and air conditioning work in tandem
automatically)
• 8-way power-adjustable driver's seat and 4-way power-adjustable front passenger seat
• Dual zone automatic climate control
• Smart Key System includes remote keyless entry system with trunk-release, panic button
and remote illuminated entry
• Auto-dimming rearview mirror and HomeLink® universal transceiver
• Power door locks with shift-linked automatic lock/unlock feature

pages.text:
2026 Mirai
Product Information
AUDIO MULTIMEDIA
• 12.3-in. Toyota Audio Multimedia, JBL Premium Audio with 14 speakers, wireless Apple
CarPlay® & Android Auto™ compatibility, SiriusXM® 3-month trial subscription.
CONNECTED SERVICES
• Service Connect — receive personalized maintenance updates and vehicle health
reports. 5-year minimum trial subscription. 4G network dependent.
• Remote Connect — remotely interact with your vehicle through the Toyota app via your
smartwatch. Allows you to lock/unlock doors, start and stop the vehicle, locate your
last parked location, check vehicle status and monitor guest drivers. 1-year trial
subscription. 4G network dependent.
• Drive Connect — includes Cloud Navigation with Google Points of Interest (POI) data,
Intelligent Assistant with Hey, Toyota, and Destination Assist. 1-year trial subscription.
4G network dependent.
• Safety Connect® — includes Emergency Assistance button, enhanced Roadside
Assistance, Automatic Collision Notification and Stolen Vehicle Locator. 5-year
minimum trial subscription. 4G network dependent.
• Wi-Fi Connect — includes AT&T Wi-Fi hotspot and Integrated Streaming (Apple Music®
and Amazon Music) compatibility. Up to 30-day/3 GB trial subscription. 4G network
dependent.
SAFETY & CONVENIENCE FEATURES
• Toyota Safety Sense™ 3.0 — Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Lane
Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Lane Tracing Assist, Automatic High Beams, Full-
Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Road Sign Assist, and Proactive Driving
Assist
• Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
• Hill Start Assist Control
• Backup camera
• Adjustable shoulder anchors on front seatbelts with seatbelt pretensioners on front
and outboard rear seats
• Star Safety System™ — includes Enhanced Vehicle Stability Control, Traction Control,
Anti-lock Brake System, Electronic Brake-force Distribution, Brake Assist, and Smart
Stop Technology®
• 3-point seatbelts for all seating positions; Driver-side Emergency Locking Retractor and
Automatic/Emergency Locking Retractors on all passenger seatbelts
• Panoramic View Monitor with 360-degree Overhead View in low-speed drive and
reverse, and Curb View
• Tire Pressure Monitor System with individual direct pressure readout
• Front and Rear Parking Assist with Automatic Braking
